headword: {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}

definitions.gloss: head-on contest; direct confrontation; fair and square fight
definitions.explanation: A straightforward, direct contest without tricks, evasion, or indirect tactics. Implies facing a challenge or opponent head-on with full force and sincerity.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}を{挑|いど}む。
examples.english: To challenge someone to a head-on contest.

examples.japanese: {小細工|こざいく}なしの{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}で{勝|か}ちたい。
examples.english: I want to win in a fair, head-on fight without tricks.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}ピッチャーが{強打者|きょうだしゃ}に{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}を{挑|いど}み、{三振|さんしん}に{打|う}ち{取|と}った。
examples.english: The young pitcher challenged the slugger head-on and struck him out.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま}っ{向|こう} (head-on, directly facing) and {勝負|しょうぶ} (contest, match). Often used in sports, especially baseball, where a pitcher throws strikes directly rather than using balls to walk a dangerous batter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}を{挑|いど}む (to challenge to a head-on fight)
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}で{戦|たたか}う (to fight head-on)
- {正々堂々|せいせいどうどう}と{真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ} (fair and square head-on contest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真|ま}っ{向|こう}{勝負|しょうぶ}: head-on, straightforward contest
- {直接対決|ちょくせつたいけつ}: direct confrontation (neutral, factual)
- {一騎打|いっきう}ち: one-on-one duel (emphasis on the matchup)
